files.path: C:/Program Files (x86)/GOG Galaxy/Games/Treasures of the Savage Frontier/PIC1.DAX
files.label: PIC1 (animated scenes)
files.note: VGA compressed picture, 66 frames of 88x88. Six 798-byte blocks (#38/47/48/57/68/70), once undecoded, are now read as a distinct, pixel-less palette record: zero width/height, a 223-colour 6-bit-DAC palette at base 0x20, and a 119-byte uninterpreted tail. Each shows here as a 16x14 swatch of its own decoded palette, not a picture — nothing was drawn this size by the original game.
